name: HottyCode: highlighted source
description: Source code as a code viewer shows it, highlighted for its language with the theme's roles: Go with line numbers and marked lines (a highlighted range, an error), an excerpt of a change to a Python file from line 40 (a removed and an added line, cut at the edge rather than wrapped; on a host it scrolls sideways), and a fenced TypeScript block in a Text. HottyCode has no height of its own: a long listing goes in a HottyScrollView.
